codeReview.summary: The feature handoff claims full cross-area integration verification, but required coverage is incomplete for key blocking assertions (spatial accuracy, photo-attachment e2e, and refresh network-source proof).

issues.description: Interactive checks do not provide the required marker-to-route distance evidence for VAL-CROSS-004 (within 500m). Validation contract requires coordinate/distance proof, but handoff only states qualitative map/gallery observations. See required assertion at validation-contract.md:199-201.

No explicit Add Photos -> Google Photos Picker -> download -> map markers + gallery verification is recorded for #otb. VAL-CROSS-008 requires this end-to-end flow in a single session with screenshot sequence evidence (validation-contract.md:215-217).

Hard-refresh verification lacks required network evidence that no Strava or Google Photos API calls occurred on reload. VAL-CROSS-005 requires network-log proof of Firebase-only data loads (validation-contract.md:203-205).

Handoff commitId does not resolve in git (`git show` fails for 760670c670ce46849842f1f54497554d3101859c). The resolvable commit is short hash 760670c -> 760670c764833b5d789304b079591928076a353c, which weakens traceability for automated review tooling.

sharedStateObservations.observation: fullstack-worker procedure requires typecheck + lint + vitest, but this run recorded only vitest/curl while still marking followedProcedure=true with no deviations. Either the skill needs a verification-only variant or handoff guidance should require explicit deviations.
No procedural check appears to enforce that handoff commitId is a resolvable full SHA before completion.

summary: Review failed: core cross-area assertions were not fully evidenced in the handoff (spatial accuracy threshold, photo-attachment e2e, and refresh network-source proof). Commit traceability metadata is also inconsistent due to a non-resolving full commit hash.
